name: Minecraft (Prism Launcher, the PowStation pack)
purpose: Minecraft modpacks as a PowOS app: Prism Launcher (Arch Linux ARM's aarch64 build; its LWJGL has linux-arm64 natives), Java 21 and powos-minecraft, which turns the server's own .mrpack (packs.json: create121 = http://mcpack.pow/pack/pack.mrpack, the file minecraft-create121's server installs from) into a Prism instance and re-syncs it at every start (only what changed; nothing changed = stat()s), so client and server never drift. Drawer entry dev.powos.minecraft.desktop -> `powos-minecraft launch` (joins 192.168.50.100:25565). The game runs on the phone's Mesa (freedreno GL 4.3 over KGSL, or zink on Turnip; /usr/share/powos/minecraft/env holds the measured choice). Data: ~/.local/share/PrismLauncher (instances, libraries, the user's Microsoft sign-in), ~/.cache/powos/minecraft (the .mrpack + a sha1 blob cache of the mods).
installedBy: targets/android/pkgs/powos-minecraft (pacman -U through tools/phone/verify/pkg-install.sh, its repo dependencies from targets/android/out/pkgs-repo)
unbounded: the game's Java heap is bounded by -Xmx (powos-minecraft: 40% of RAM, 4-8 GB); a cgroup of its own would keep powos-sleepd from freezing it out of sight (it moves only processes in the root v2 cgroup)
